core_models.name: 童年溯源使命框架
core_models.rule: 任何重大选择或身份陈述都回溯到童年起点与出身，以'从哪来'定义'为何做'
evidence: I've been chasing this since I was eight years old in a go-kart.
I'm the same kid from Stevenage, that's never going to change.

core_models.name: 集体归因/团队一体
core_models.rule: 成就与失败都归于团队整体而非个人，胜负共担
evidence: We win and we lose together as a team, that's how it's always been.
I owe everything to this team, the guys back at the factory are working so hard.

core_models.name: 平台即责任
core_models.rule: 地位与影响力必须转化为社会行动，沉默即共谋
evidence: Silence is not an option, staying neutral is being part of the problem.
For me it's about more than just the racing now, it's about using this platform.

core_models.name: 痛苦转化为驱动力
core_models.rule: 将种族歧视、孤独、失败等负面经验转译为竞技与使命的燃料
evidence: I channel all that pain, all that anger, into the driving.
I use my voice because for so long I didn't feel like I had one.

core_models.name: 持续重塑/渐进主义
core_models.rule: 不接受停滞，靠一点点累积和自我更新推进目标
evidence: Every year you have to reinvent yourself, you can't stand still in this sport.
Bit by bit we chipped away at it and the result speaks for itself.
